subject: Finalize POC gates, owners & book exec review
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara King <sara.king@clearpathhealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed POC success gates

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a concrete next step to get the POC scheduled:

TL;DR — ClearPath wants a 3-week technical evaluation focused on triage automation for inbound support tickets. Success = 1) >=40% reduction in manual triage time for high-volume queues (pilot subset), 2) no data exfiltration and logs available for audit, 3) maintained user-facing response latency <250ms for inference calls.

From our side we propose:
- Week 0 (prep): infra access, sample dataset + schema, shared test account.
- Week 1–2 (trial): run model-in-the-loop on anonymized sample traffic, measure throughput/latency and accuracy against your labeling set.
- Week 3 (readout): internal readout + exec 30-min decision slot (go/no-go).

Action items for you (please confirm by EOD Mon):
- Confirm success criteria above or propose edits (I attached a one-sheet).
- Confirm availability for an exec readout week of Mar 20–24 (30 minutes, exec + product).
- Provide a point of contact for procurement so we can pre-share the minimal SOW and data handling addendum.

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx (one-sheet); Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (draft).

If that timeline works we’ll assign owners on our side and send a short runbook for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference
From: Sara King <sara.king@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearpathhealth.com>, ClearPath Health Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed POC success gates

Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:
1) Success criteria: the 40% reduction target is reasonable but we need a secondary metric for precision on triage labels (target F1 >= 0.82 on our holdout set).
2) Data access: we will provide a redacted/anonymized export of 30k tickets; security team needs the data handling addendum before sharing samples.
3) Exec slot: Mar 22 (Thu) morning PT looks best for our CTO + Head of Product. Can you hold a 30-min slot on Mar 22 at 10:00am PT?

Procurement (cc) — we will need a short SOW and a data addendum to review. Budget has been provisionally approved pending a successful readout.

On the samples: please send the minimal schema we need to map to (we already shared the ticket fields doc in the discovery folder).

Thanks —
Sara
Sara King
VP Product, ClearPath Health
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ClearPath POC — owners, infra and readout prep

Jonas / Monica —

Follow-up from discovery: ClearPath confirmed the high-level gates and asked for an exec readout on Mar 22 at 10:00am PT. Please see the customer asks below — we need to lock owners and surface any blockers by Mon EOD.

Customer asks:
- Provide data schema checklist so they can map fields (security requires this before sample handoff).
- Run anonymized run on 30k-ticket export; provide latency/throughput and accuracy metrics; compare against their holdout.
- Provide evidence of no data exfiltration (audit logs + network egress config) and a short KMS/HSM note.

Proposed owners:
- Infra/setup & audit logs: Jonas Weber (I.T. infra + private deployment liaison).
- Evaluation metrics & dashboard: Monica Patel (Solutions Analytics).
- SOW & pricing chatter: grace_oconnor (I'll own the MAP + billing path until procurement takes over).

Attachments: Redwood-POC-runbook.pdf (draft) — includes sample queries, test harness, and metric definitions.

If any of this conflicts with capacity let me know. We should also prepare a 10-slide readout template with: objective, setup, metric baselines, trial results, risks & recommended next step (contract path).

Grace
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara King <sara.king@clearpathhealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, ClearPath Health Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: POC runbook, acceptance tests, and proposed schedule (Mar 27 start)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Per our internal alignment, attaching the POC runbook and the one-sheet with acceptance tests. Summary of the plan:
- Kickoff (Week 0): Mar 27 — access + data mapping, redaction verification, network whitelist.
- Trial window: Mar 28–Apr 10 — daily automated runs with sample batches, weekly scorecard.
- Exec readout: Apr 12 at 10:00am PT (30 min) — internal decision to follow that same day.

Note: you asked for Mar 22 earlier — we pushed to Apr 12 to give us time to finalize the network and audit configs with your security team. If Mar 22 is firm on your side we can compress but will need signed addendum and expedited access.

Please confirm:
- Do you accept the runbook as-is (attached) and the proposed Apr 12 readout?
- Share the procurement contact who should receive the SOW (we've prep a short SOW draft).

Attachments: Redwood-POC-runbook.pdf, POC-success-criteria.xlsx, Mutual-Action-Plan.docx

Best —
Grace
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara King <sara.king@clearpathhealth.com>, ClearPath Health Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC runbook, acceptance tests, and proposed schedule (Mar 27 start)

Grace / team —

Thanks, the runbook looks thorough. We ran this by security and procurement. Two quick notes:
- Security confirmed the redaction checklist; they want the audit log sample and KMS note before we share tickets. Can you send the sample audit log payload and KMS config snippet by EOD Fri?
- Procurement: we reviewed the short SOW and are good to move forward — sending our redlines via DocuSign (link below).

Readout: we prefer Apr 12 at 10:00am PT. Please reserve that slot and we'll invite CTO + Head of Product. If you can send a 10-slide readout template with placeholders by Mon we'll pull internal stakeholders into the prep.

DocuSign: https://docusign.clearpath/CPH-POC-SOW

Appreciate the quick turn.

Best —
Tom Hsu
Director of Engineering, ClearPath Health
